name: Westfield Valencia Town Center
description: Westfield Valencia Town Center is a premier regional shopping destination in the Santa Clarita Valley, featuring over 170 stores and restaurants across 1.1 million square feet. This upscale enclosed mall offers an exceptional mix of fashion retailers, dining options, and entertainment venues including brands like Zara, H&M, Uniqlo, and Victoria's Secret. With world-class amenities and convenient technology like Smart Parking and click-and-collect services, it provides both quick shopping trips and all-day experiences for the community.
summary: A premier 1.1 million square foot regional mall in Valencia offering 170+ stores, upscale dining, and modern shopping amenities in the heart of the Santa Clarita Valley.
